draftUse.basis: Only validated concurrency ownership/cancellation cards apply.

applicabilityReason: Early-yield requests race output consumption, process exit, cancellation and backend replacement.

selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Queued UI requests may outlive thread/backend ownership.
Yield must not replace cancellation or discard already-drained output.

facts.statement: Delegated contract requires exact ownership and existing-process lifetime to survive early yield, cancellation and backend replacement.

invariants.statement: Stale thread/call/process or reconnect generation sends no process-control action.
invariants.scope: TUI queued command and unified-exec startup token

invariants.statement: Early yield returns the current collector output once and preserves process/PTY ownership; exit/cancellation/deadline remain resolved by the existing response and cleanup path.
invariants.scope: Initial resumable unified-exec collection; one-shot completion is unsupported

designChoices.statement: Add a request token only to the existing resumable startup collector; retain the existing response, process store and cleanup.
designChoices.rationale: The startup already owns the exact process and bounded output; a second runner or cancellable collector future would break continuity.

verificationObligations.requiredEnvironment: TUI recording app-server and core manager tests
verificationObligations.failureOracle: Any RPC for stale thread/generation, or accepted wrong call/process owner, is a failure.

verificationObligations.requiredEnvironment: Production collector component plus actual Windows/Unix shell startup and write/stop
verificationObligations.failureOracle: Lost/duplicated output, another spawn/PID/PTY, early slot release, or yield overriding terminal cleanup is a failure.
